file_info:
  document_title: "JUSTIFICATION REVIEW DOCUMENT FOR EXCEPTION TO FAIR OPPORTUNITY – BRAND NAME"
  file_name: "FAR_Part_16_Brand_Name_JEFO_MANDATORY_v3.docx"
  brief_description: >
    Department of the Army template for a Justification for Exception to Fair Opportunity (JEFO)
    under FAR 16.505, specifically for brand-name requirements on multiple award IDIQ orders.
    Designed to document rationale, approvals, and routing for brand-name selections.

  main_sections:
    - title: "CUI Reminder / Banner"
      description: >
        Introductory notice reminding users to apply appropriate Controlled Unclassified
        Information (CUI) markings and the CUI Designation Box in accordance with DoDI 5200.48.
      contents:
        - Text reminding user to mark top/bottom of each page with CUI markings if applicable
        - Instruction to remove CUI banner and designation box if document is determined not to be CUI

    - title: "Document Header"
      description: "Identifies the document as a JEFO for brand-name acquisitions and cites authority."
      contents:
        - "JUSTIFICATION REVIEW DOCUMENT FOR EXCEPTION TO FAIR OPPORTUNITY – BRAND NAME"
        - Field: "Supply/Service:" (blank line to specify the supply or service)
        - "Authority: Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 16.505(b)(2)(i)(B) and FAR 16.505(a)(4)"

    - title: "Preparation and Contact Information"
      description: "Identifies key personnel preparing and supporting the justification."
      subsections:
        - title: "Prepared by"
          fields:
            - "Prepared by: Insert Name"
            - "PN:" (phone number)
            - "Insert Title"
            - "Email:"
        - title: "Contracting Officer"
          fields:
            - "Contracting Officer: Insert Name"
            - "PN:"
            - "Insert Title"
            - "Email:"
        - title: "Technical"
          fields:
            - "Technical: Insert Name"
            - "PN:"
            - "Insert Title"
            - "Email:"
        - title: "Requirements"
          fields:
            - "Requirements: Insert Name"
            - "PN:"
            - "Insert Title"
            - "Email:"

    - title: "Review and Signature Routing"
      description: >
        Signature blocks and routing instructions for required reviewers/approvers.
        Some blocks are conditional based on JEFO approval level.
      instructions:
        - "Reviews: I have reviewed this justification and find it adequate to support an exception to fair opportunity."
        - Note to revise signatures according to required reviews and to see ACC-RI PCF policy for routing.
      signature_blocks:
        - role: "Program Manager"
          fields:
            - "Program Manager: Insert Name"
            - "PN:"
            - "Signature:"
        - role: "Program Executive Officer (PEO)"
          conditions: "Only for SPE-level JEFO that supports a PEO-managed program"
          fields:
            - "Program Executive Officer: Insert Name"
            - "PN:"
            - "Signature:"
        - role: "Legal Advisor"
          fields:
            - "Legal Advisor: Insert Name"
            - "PN:"
            - "Signature:"
        - role: "Competition Advocate"
          conditions: "Only for SES or SPE-level JEFO"
          fields:
            - "Competition Advocate: Insert Name"
            - "PN:"
            - "Signature:"
        - role: "Chief Counsel"
          conditions: "Only for SPE-level JEFO"
          fields:
            - "Chief Counsel: Insert Name"
            - "PN:"
            - "Signature:"
        - role: "Senior Contracting Official"
          notes: "Pre-populated with a specific name in this version"
          fields:
            - "Senior Contracting Official: Lynda R. Armer"
            - "PN:"
            - "Signature:"
          conditions: "Only for SPE-level JEFO"

    - title: "Justification Body (Department of the Army JEFO Narrative)"
      description: >
        Narrative portion of the justification, formatted as a standard Army JEFO under
        multiple award IDIQ procedures. The visible portion indicates a standard structure
        for explaining the brand-name exception, though only the heading is partially shown
        in the extracted text.
      contents:
        - Heading: "Department of the Army"
        - Heading: "Justification for Exception to Fair Opportunity - Brand Name"
        - Intro reference: "Under Multiple Award Indefinite De..." (likely continues to "Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contracts")
      expected_subsections (inferred from standard JEFO formats, but not fully visible):
        - Background / Contract Vehicle Identification
        - Description of Supplies/Services and Brand-Name Requirement
        - Statutory/Regulatory Authority
        - Rationale for Brand-Name Selection
        - Market Research Summary
        - Efforts to Foster Competition
        - Determination that Prices are Fair and Reasonable
        - Technical and Requirements Certification Statements
        - Approvals and Certification Statements

  fillable_or_logical_fields:
    - section: "Document Header"
      fields:
        - name: "Supply/Service"
          type: "free-text"
          description: "Describe the specific supply or service being acquired."

    - section: "Prepared by"
      fields:
        - name: "Prepared by - Name"
          type: "free-text"
        - name: "Prepared by - PN"
          type: "phone/contact number"
        - name: "Prepared by - Title"
          type: "free-text"
        - name: "Prepared by - Email"
          type: "email"

    - section: "Contracting Officer"
      fields:
        - name: "Contracting Officer - Name"
          type: "free-text"
        - name: "Contracting Officer - PN"
          type: "phone/contact number"
        - name: "Contracting Officer - Title"
          type: "free-text"
        - name: "Contracting Officer - Email"
          type: "email"

    - section: "Technical"
      fields:
        - name: "Technical - Name"
          type: "free-text"
        - name: "Technical - PN"
          type: "phone/contact number"
        - name: "Technical - Title"
          type: "free-text"
        - name: "Technical - Email"
          type: "email"

    - section: "Requirements"
      fields:
        - name: "Requirements - Name"
          type: "free-text"
        - name: "Requirements - PN"
          type: "phone/contact number"
        - name: "Requirements - Title"
          type: "free-text"
        - name: "Requirements - Email"
          type: "email"

    - section: "Program Manager Signature Block"
      fields:
        - name: "Program Manager - Name"
          type: "free-text"
        - name: "Program Manager - PN"
          type: "phone/contact number"
        - name: "Program Manager - Signature"
          type: "signature/date (manual or digital)"

    - section: "Program Executive Officer (PEO) Signature Block"
      conditional_on: "SPE-level JEFO supporting PEO-managed program"
      fields:
        - name: "PEO - Name"
          type: "free-text"
        - name: "PEO - PN"
          type: "phone/contact number"
        - name: "PEO - Signature"
          type: "signature/date"

    - section: "Legal Advisor Signature Block"
      fields:
        - name: "Legal Advisor - Name"
          type: "free-text"
        - name: "Legal Advisor - PN"
          type: "phone/contact number"
        - name: "Legal Advisor - Signature"
          type: "signature/date"

    - section: "Competition Advocate Signature Block"
      conditional_on: "SES or SPE-level JEFO"
      fields:
        - name: "Competition Advocate - Name"
          type: "free-text"
        - name: "Competition Advocate - PN"
          type: "phone/contact number"
        - name: "Competition Advocate - Signature"
          type: "signature/date"

    - section: "Chief Counsel Signature Block"
      conditional_on: "SPE-level JEFO"
      fields:
        - name: "Chief Counsel - Name"
          type: "free-text"
        - name: "Chief Counsel - PN"
          type: "phone/contact number"
        - name: "Chief Counsel - Signature"
          type: "signature/date"

    - section: "Senior Contracting Official Signature Block"
      conditional_on: "SPE-level JEFO"
      fields:
        - name: "Senior Contracting Official - Name"
          type: "pre-populated (Lynda R. Armer in this version) or free-text in other versions"
        - name: "Senior Contracting Official - PN"
          type: "phone/contact number"
        - name: "Senior Contracting Official - Signature"
          type: "signature/date"

    - section: "JEFO Narrative"
      fields (likely, based on typical structure though not fully visible):
        - name: "Contract/Task Order Number"
          type: "free-text"
        - name: "Contract Vehicle / IDIQ Name"
          type: "free-text"
        - name: "Description of Brand-Name Item/Service"
          type: "free-text, narrative"
        - name: "Estimated Value / Dollar Amount"
          type: "currency"
        - name: "Rationale for Brand Name"
          type: "narrative justification"
        - name: "Summary of Market Research"
          type: "narrative"
        - name: "Impact if Brand-Name Not Used"
          type: "narrative"
        - name: "Certifications / Determinations"
          type: "checkbox or narrative"

  placeholders_and_instructions:
    - text: "Insert Name"
      usage: "Used throughout for all roles until actual personnel names are filled in."
    - text: "Insert Title"
      usage: "Used throughout for job titles of preparer, contracting officer, technical and requirements personnel."
    - text: "Email:"
      usage: "Blank line following label to insert email address."
    - text: "PN:"
      usage: "Phone number or contact number placeholder for each named individual."
    - text: "Reviews: I have reviewed this justification and find it adequate to support an exception to fair opportunity."
      usage: "Introductory statement to the review/signature routing section."
    - text: "Revise the following signatures according to reviews required. See ACC-RI PCF policy for complete routing instructions."
      usage: "Instruction to tailor which signature blocks are used and how the document is routed."
    - text: "(Only for SPE-level JEFO that supports a PEO-managed program)"
      usage: "Condition note attached to the Program Executive Officer signature block."
    - text: "(Only for SES or SPE-level JEFO)"
      usage: "Condition note attached to the Competition Advocate signature block."
    - text: "(Only for SPE-level JEFO)"
      usage: "Condition note attached to Chief Counsel and Senior Contracting Official signature blocks."
    - text: "REMINDER: The appropriate Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) markings..."
      usage: "Instructional block to apply/remove CUI markings and CUI Designation Box as applicable."
    - layout_placeholders:
        - "Blank lines next to each label (Name, PN, Title, Email, Signature) for manual or electronic entry."
        - "Signature lines beneath each role where signatures/dates are to be applied."
        - "CUI designation box location on lower right of first page (implied; user must ensure correct marking)."

file_info:
  document_title: "FAR Part 16 JEFO Bridge MANDATORY v3"
  brief_description: >
    Department of the Army template for a Justification for Exception to Fair Opportunity (JEFO)
    under FAR 16.505(b)(2)(i)(C), specifically for non-competitive “bridge” actions under
    multiple-award indefinite-delivery contracts. Designed to be tailored and routed for
    approvals at various levels (e.g., Program Manager, Competition Advocate, SPE-level).

  main_sections:
    - title: "CUI Marking Reminder"
      description: >
        Introductory reminder text directing users to apply correct Controlled Unclassified
        Information (CUI) markings, designation box, and banners in accordance with DoDI 5200.48
        and DoD CUI Program guidance, or remove them if the document is not CUI.
      notes: "Instructional only; not typically edited except to remove if not CUI."

    - title: "Document Header / Cover Information"
      description: >
        Basic identification of the document as a Justification Review Document For Exception to
        Fair Opportunity, including supply/service description, statutory/regulatory authority,
        and preparer information.
      fields:
        - "Supply/Service description line"
        - "Authority reference (e.g., FAR 16.505(b)(2)(i)(C))"
        - "Prepared by (name, phone number, title/role such as Contract Specialist)"
        - "Email of preparer"
        - "Contracting Officer (name, phone number, email)"
        - "Technical POC (name, phone number, title, email)"
        - "Requirements POC (name, phone number, title, email)"

    - title: "Review and Approval Signatures"
      description: >
        Section capturing concurrence and approval routing for the justification, with role-based
        signature blocks and conditional use notes for different approval levels.
      reviewers_and_approvers:
        - role: "Program Manager"
          fields:
            - "Name"
            - "PN (phone number)"
            - "Signature"
        - role: "Program Executive Officer"
          applicability: "Only for SPE-level JEFO that supports a PEO-managed program"
          fields:
            - "Name"
            - "PN (phone number)"
            - "Signature"
        - role: "Legal Advisor"
          fields:
            - "Name"
            - "PN (phone number)"
            - "Signature"
        - role: "Competition Advocate"
          applicability: "Only for SES or SPE-level JEFO"
          fields:
            - "Name"
            - "PN (phone number)"
            - "Signature"
        - role: "Chief Counsel"
          applicability: "Only for SPE-level JEFO"
          fields:
            - "Name"
            - "PN (phone number)"
            - "Signature"
        - role: "Senior Contracting Official"
          default_name: "Lynda R. Armer"
          applicability: "Only for SPE-level JEFO"
          fields:
            - "PN (phone number)"
            - "Signature"
      notes:
        - >
          Instructional text: “I have reviewed this justification and find it adequate to support
          an exception to fair opportunity. (Revise the following signatures according to reviews
          required. See ACC-RI PCF policy for complete routing instructions.)”

    - title: "Bridge Definition (Instructional Text)"
      description: >
        Embedded explanatory section defining “bridge” actions as non-competitive actions justified
        to retain the current or similar product/service due to delays in follow-on contract award.
        Provides examples and conditions covering:
        - Modifications extending period of performance or cost/value of an existing order
        - Interim sole-source orders as gap coverage
        - Use of FAR 52.217-8 Option to Extend Services and when it becomes a bridge
      notes:
        - "Explicit instruction: '[Remove this text when preparing a bridge JEFO]'."
        - "This block is guidance only and should not remain in finalized justifications."

    - title: "Justification Body – Standard FAR 16.505 JEFO Format"
      description: >
        Numbered justification narrative following Army format for JEFO under multiple-award
        indefinite-delivery contracts. At least the first numbered paragraph is visible.
      subsections:
        - number: "1"
          title: "Contracting Activity"
          content_summary: >
            Identifies the contracting activity as U.S. Army Contracting Command – Rock Island
            (ACC-RI), including full mailing address at Rock Island Arsenal.
          fields:
            - "Activity name (pre-populated: ACC-RI)"
            - "Address (pre-populated; may be updated if template reused elsewhere)"

        - number: "2"
          title: "Description of Action"
          content_summary: >
            Narrative describing the type of bridge action (task order, delivery order, or
            modification), associated contract numbers, contractor name, multiple-award contract
            vehicle, planned award timing, and funding details. Includes selectable scenario
            language related to acquisition planning requirements.
          fields:
            - "Customer’s office name (e.g., The Logistics Modernization Program Project Office)"
            - "Type of contract/vehicle (e.g., firm-fixed-price, cost-reimbursement, etc.)"
            - "Type of action (bridge task order, bridge delivery order, or bridge modification)"
            - "Order/contract numbers (e.g., W52P1J/W519TC-XX-X-XXXX)"
            - "Contractor name"
            - "Multiple award contract name (e.g., CHESS ITES-3H or other MAC ID/IQ)"
            - "Projected award month and year (Month 20YY)"
            - "Fiscal year of funds (FY 20YY)"
            - "Type of funds (e.g., OMA, OPA, etc.)"
            - "Acquisition plan scenario selection (1–4) with applicable justification text"
          scenario_options:
            - id: 1
              text: >
                Acquisition plan not required because the procurement does not meet the DFARS
                207.103(d)(i)(B) threshold.
            - id: 2
              text: >
                Acquisition plan not required IAW DFARS 207.103(e) because the action is included
                in a specified program-level acquisition plan (e.g., LOGCAP).
              fillable: "Program name/plan identifier (e.g., LOGCAP)"
            - id: 3
              text: >
                Approval authority waived the detail and formality of the acquisition plan IAW
                FAR 7.103(m) due to a compressed delivery/performance schedule.
              fillable:
                - "Approval authority title"
                - "Waiver date"
            - id: 4
              text: >
                Approval authority approved an acquisition plan IAW DFARS 207.103(d)(i)(B) on a
                given date, or notes that approval is pending.
              fillable:
                - "Approval authority title"
                - "Acquisition plan approval date or pending status"
            - id: 5
              applicability: "Modifications to existing orders (bridge mods)"
              note: "Mentioned in narrative; details likely follow later in the document."
            - id: 6
              applicability: "Modifications to existing orders (alternative scenario)"
              note: "Mentioned in narrative; specific text likely in subsequent pages."

  fillable_or_logical_fields_summary:
    person_identification:
      - "Prepared by: name, phone (PN), title, email"
      - "Contracting Officer: name, PN, email"
      - "Technical POC: name, PN, title, email"
      - "Requirements POC: name, PN, title, email"
      - "Program Manager: name, PN, signature"
      - "Program Executive Officer: name, PN, signature (conditional)"
      - "Legal Advisor: name, PN, signature"
      - "Competition Advocate: name, PN, signature (conditional)"
      - "Chief Counsel: name, PN, signature (conditional)"
      - "Senior Contracting Official: PN, signature (name may be pre-populated)"

    acquisition_parameters:
      - "Supply/Service title/description"
      - "Applicable authority citation (FAR 16.505(b)(2)(i)(C) or updates)"
      - "Contract/Order/Modification numbers"
      - "Type of contract (FFP, cost-reimbursement, etc.)"
      - "Type of bridge action (task order, delivery order, modification)"
      - "Multiple-award contract name/vehicle"
      - "Projected award date (month/year)"
      - "Fiscal year and type of funds"
      - "Selected acquisition-planning scenario and supporting details/waivers"

    routing_and_approval_logic:
      - "Inclusion or exclusion of certain reviewer roles based on JEFO approval level (e.g., SES, SPE)."
      - "Requirement to align routing with ACC-RI PCF policy."
      - "Conditional text blocks that must be deleted if not applicable (e.g., bridge definition note, scenario variations)."

  placeholders_and_instructions:
    - placeholder: "Insert Name"
      usage: "Used across technical, requirements, and reviewer roles where specific individuals are to be named."
    - placeholder: "PN:"
      usage: "Phone number field for each person/role."
    - placeholder: "Insert Title"
      usage: "Role/title for technical and requirements points of contact."
    - placeholder: "Insert customer’s office (e.g., The Logistics Modernization Program Project Office)"
      usage: "Customer requiring the bridge action."
    - placeholder: "type of contract (e.g., firm-fixed-price, cost-reimbursement, etc.)"
      usage: "Select or describe contract type."
    - placeholder: "bridge task order, bridge delivery order or bridge modification"
      usage: "Select one specific action type and delete others."
    - placeholder: "W52P1J/W519TC-XX-X-XXXX"
      usage: "Template contract/order numbers to be replaced with actual number(s)."
    - placeholder: "contractor name"
      usage: "Actual contractor performing under the bridge action."
    - placeholder: "multiple award contract name (e.g., CHESS ITES-3H)"
      usage: "Name/acronym of MAC/IDIQ vehicle."
    - placeholder: "Month 20YY / fiscal year 20YY"
      usage: "Planned award month/year and funding fiscal year."
    - placeholder: "funds type (e.g., Operations and Maintenance, Army or Other Procurement Army)"
      usage: "Funding appropriation/line description."
    - placeholder: "XXXX (e.g., LOGCAP)"
      usage: "Program-level acquisition plan or program name."
    - instruction: "[Remove this text when preparing a bridge JEFO]"
      usage: "Explicit directive to delete the instructional bridge definition block in final documents."
    - instruction: "Choose one of the following six scenarios to address the acquisition plan."
      usage: "User must select and retain only the applicable scenario(s) and remove the rest."
    - instruction: "Revise the following signatures according to reviews required."
      usage: "Tailor signature blocks to the specific routing chain and JEFO approval level."

  formatting_and_layout_notes:
    - "Document is structured for Word with paragraph-based fill-ins rather than form fields."
    - "Some example values are pre-populated as guidance (e.g., ACC-RI, CHESS/ITES-3H, LOGCAP, Lynda R. Armer)."
    - "CUI reminder and bridge definition sections are guidance blocks that may be removed in the final signed justification."
    - "Numbered justification paragraphs (1., 2., etc.) continue beyond the visible excerpt and follow standard JEFO structure (e.g., description of supplies/services, statutory authority, efforts to promote competition, etc.)."

file_info:
  file_name: FAR_Part_16_JEFO_MANDATORY_v3.docx
  document_title: "Justification Review Document for Exception to Fair Opportunity (JEFO)"
  brief_description: >
    Mandatory Department of the Army template for preparing a Justification
    for Exception to Fair Opportunity under FAR 16.505(b)(2). It guides
    contracting personnel and supporting offices through the content,
    certifications, and approvals required when limiting fair opportunity
    among multiple award IDIQ contract holders.

  main_sections:
    - heading: CUI Marking Reminder
      description: >
        Instructions on Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) banner and
        designation box placement or removal depending on the document’s
        classification.

    - heading: Front Matter / Routing & Identification
      description: >
        Cover-style information identifying the action, authority, and key
        personnel for preparation and review.
      subsections:
        - heading: Document Header
          description: "Title: JUSTIFICATION REVIEW DOCUMENT FOR EXCEPTION TO FAIR OPPORTUNITY."
        - heading: Supply/Service
          description: "Open field to identify whether the action is for supplies and/or services."
        - heading: Authority
          description: >
            Statement referencing FAR 16.505(b)(2)(i)(A)–(E) directing the
            preparer to choose one authority.

    - heading: Preparer and Key Personnel Information
      description: >
        Identification and contact information for the preparer and principal
        stakeholders.
      subsections:
        - heading: Prepared by
          description: "Name, title, phone number (PN), and email for the person drafting the justification."
        - heading: Contracting Officer
          description: "Name, title, PN, and email for the contracting officer."
        - heading: Technical
          description: "Name, title, PN, and email for the technical representative."
        - heading: Requirements
          description: "Name, title, PN, and email for the requirements owner."

    - heading: Review and Signature Routing Block
      description: >
        Signature lines and routing guidance for reviewing officials who must
        concur in the justification, adjusted per ACC-RI policy and approval
        thresholds.
      subsections:
        - heading: Program Manager
          description: "Name, PN, and signature line."
        - heading: Program Executive Officer
          description: >
            Name, PN, signature line; only used for SPE-level JEFO supporting a
            PEO-managed program.
        - heading: Legal Advisor
          description: "Name, PN, and signature line."
        - heading: Competition Advocate
          description: >
            Name, PN, and signature; used only for SES or SPE-level JEFOs.
        - heading: Chief Counsel
          description: >
            Name, PN, and signature; used only for SPE-level JEFOs.
        - heading: Senior Contracting Official
          description: >
            Pre-populated name (Lynda R. Armer), PN, and signature line; used
            only for SPE-level JEFOs.

    - heading: Main Justification Body
      description: >
        Numbered paragraphs 1–12 that must be tailored to the specific
        acquisition, documenting the rationale for limiting fair opportunity,
        market research, certification, and required approvals.
      subsections:
        - heading: 1. Contracting Activity
          description: >
            Identifies the contracting activity (pre-populated as ACC-RI with
            full address).
        - heading: 2. Description of Action
          description: >
            Narrative description of the contractual action, contract type,
            vehicle, funding, timing, and acquisition planning status, with
            alternative boilerplate options to select and tailor.
        - heading: 3. Description of Supplies/Services
          description: >
            Description of the supplies or services, quantities or period of
            performance, options (if any), estimated dollar value, and basis
            for the estimate.
        - heading: 4. Authority Cited
          description: >
            List of the five JEFO authorities in FAR 16.505(b)(2)(i)(A)–(E);
            preparer must select the one applicable authority.
        - heading: 5. Reason for Authority Cited
          description: >
            Detailed explanation requirement for why the chosen authority
            applies, with separate guidance for urgency, only-one-capable,
            follow-on, minimum guarantee, or statutory source exceptions.
        - heading: 6. Market Research
          description: >
            Description of market research conducted among contract holders,
            timing (within 18 months), responses, capabilities, and why other
            sources cannot meet the requirement.
        - heading: 7. Actions to Increase Competition
          description: >
            Planned or completed actions to enhance competition in current or
            future acquisitions, with special emphasis on prior JEFO follow-on
            situations.
        - heading: 8. Other Facts
          description: >
            Additional facts supporting limited competition, including
            procurement history and potential use of a class JEFO.
          subsubsections:
            - heading: 8.a Procurement History
              description: >
                Prior contract information (contract number, contractor, award
                date, competitive status, and authority if applicable), with an
                option to use a table if more than five actions.
            - heading: 8.b Class JEFO
              description: >
                Statement addressing whether a class JEFO applies to cover
                future actions and the requirement for a memorandum of
                applicability.
        - heading: 9. Technical Certification
          description: >
            Certification statement and signature block for the technical
            representative affirming accuracy and completeness of supporting
            data.
        - heading: 10. Requirements Certification
          description: >
            Certification statement and signature block for the requirements
            representative affirming accuracy and completeness of supporting
            data.
        - heading: 11. Fair and Reasonable Cost Determination
          description: >
            Contracting officer narrative and certification that anticipated
            cost/price is fair and reasonable, including basis (price/cost
            analysis methods, IGCE, audit, and FAR 15.403 applicability).
        - heading: 12. Contracting Officer Certification
          description: >
            Contracting officer certification that the justification is
            accurate and complete.

    - heading: Approval Page
      description: >
        Approval language and signature blocks for the approving official(s)
        authorizing use of a JEFO, with templates for Competition Advocate,
        SES/SCO, and Senior Procurement Executive as applicable. Includes
        statement that CO signature in paragraph 14 (noted in template) may
        serve as approval in some cases.

    - heading: Final Review and Formatting Guidance
      description: >
        Instructions and reminders for finalizing the document: redaction
        guidance reference, removal of unused signature blocks and acronyms,
        non-use of personal tense, spacing rules, and advice to use the
        Show/Hide feature to check formatting.

  fillable_or_logical_fields:
    - label: Supply/Service
      type: free_text
      description: "Identify whether the procurement is for supplies, services, or both."

    - label: Authority (FAR 16.505(b)(2)(i)(A)-(E))
      type: single_select
      options:
        - "(A) Urgent need; fair opportunity would cause unacceptable delays."
        - "(B) Only one awardee capable; unique or highly specialized."
        - "(C) Logical follow-on to a previously competed order."
        - "(D) Order to satisfy a minimum guarantee."
        - "(E) Statute requires purchase from specified source (over SAT)."

    - label: Prepared by - Name

  placeholders_and_boilerplate:
    - text: "Insert Name"
      meaning: "Replace with the full name of the individual in that role."
    - text: "Insert Title"
      meaning: "Replace with the position title or role of the individual."
    - text: "Email:"
      meaning: "Replace with the individual's email address."
    - text: "PN:"
      meaning: "Replace with phone number or point-of-contact number."
    - text: "Insert customer’s office (e.g., The Logistics Modernization Program Project Office)"
      meaning: "Replace with the actual requesting office."
    - text: "type of contract (e.g., firm-fixed-price, cost reimbursement, etc.)"
      meaning: "Replace with the selected contract type."
    - text: "contract XXXXXX"
      meaning: "Replace with the actual contract number."
    - text: "Month 20YY"
      meaning: "Replace with actual month and year of projected award."
    - text: "fiscal year 20YY"
      meaning: "Replace with the actual fiscal year."
    - text: "funds type (e.g., Operations and Maintenance, Army or Other Procurement, Army)"
      meaning: "Replace with the specific appropriation/funding type."
    - text: "XXXX (e.g., LOGCAP) program level acquisition plan"
      meaning: "Replace with the specific program name tied to the acquisition plan."
    - text: "Approval authority title approved an acquisition plan ... on date."
      meaning: "Replace with the title of the approving authority and the approval date."
    - text: "cut and paste the previous JEFO’s paragraph 7 here"
      meaning: "Insert the text from paragraph 7 of the prior JEFO when applicable."
    - text: "Those actions were accomplished by (explain how)- or - Those actions were not accomplished due to (explain why)."
      meaning: "Replace with factual explanation of actions relative to prior JEFO commitments."
    - text: "Describe the services or item(s) to be acquired. Include quantities..."
      meaning: "Replace boilerplate with a detailed description of the requirement."
    - text: "The period of performance is DD Month 20YY through DD Month 20YY."
      meaning: "Replace with actual start and end dates."
    - text: "The proposed action will include X month or year or XX% evaluated option(s)."
      meaning: "Replace with specific option durations/percentages as applicable."
    - text: "Insert estimator title or organization estimates a dollar value of $x,xxx,xxx including options, based on ..."
      meaning: "Replace with responsible estimator/organization, actual estimated value, and basis."
    - text: "Identify the statute that expressly authorizes or requires that the purchase be made from a specified source."
      meaning: "Replace with citation of the specific statute and, if needed, description."
    - text: "Contract Number: / Contractor: / Award Date: / Competitive Status:"
      meaning: "Fields to be completed with prior contract history details."
    - text: "This class JEFO will cover all future actions..."
      meaning: "Boilerplate to be retained or removed depending on whether a class JEFO is employed."
    - text: "Based on the foregoing justification, I hereby approve the procurement of state the supplies/services being procured..."
      meaning: "Replace the embedded phrase with the specific supplies/services description."
    - text: "TYPED NAME (ALL CAPS)"
      meaning: "Replace with the printed name of the approving official in all caps."
    - text: "Senior Executive Service / Senior Contracting Official / Senior Procurement Executive"
      meaning: "Select and retain the applicable title; remove unused titles."

  formatting_and_usage_notes:
    - "Remove unused signature blocks that are not applicable to the specific approval level or routing."
    - "Do not use first-person personal pronouns (I, we, our) in the narrative sections."
    - "Use one space after each colon and between sentences, per template note."
    - "Spell out all acronyms the first time used only, then use acronyms consistently thereafter."
    - "Remove unused acronyms from the document."
    - "Use the Word Show/Hide feature to verify spacing, tabs, and paragraph alignment."
    - "If the document is determined not to be CUI, remove the CUI designation box and banners."

file_info:
  filename: Lesson_plan.docx
  description: >
    Single-page lesson plan template for a math class, containing labeled sections
    (Overview, Standards, Objectives, Materials, Verification, Activity) with mostly
    placeholder body text to be replaced with lesson-specific content.
  document_type: lesson_plan_template
  audience: teachers_instructors
  layout:
    structure: linear_headings_with_body_text
    page_count: 1
    orientation: portrait
  sections:
    - id: header
      title: "Header Information"
      content_summary: >
        Top-of-page identification information for the lesson, including subject/period,
        lesson plan title, teacher name, and date.
      elements:
        - type: static_text
          text: "Math – 1st Period"
          role: example_class_label
        - type: static_text
          text: "Lesson Plan"
          role: document_title
        - type: label_value
          label: "Teacher:"
          value_example: "Mr. Guerrero"
          role: teacher_name
        - type: label_value
          label: "Date:"
          value_example: "09/04/20XX"
          role: lesson_date
      fillable_fields:
        - name: class_or_course_name
          type: short_text
          example_value: "Math – 1st Period"
          required: true
        - name: teacher_name
          type: short_text
          example_value: "Mr. Guerrero"
          required: true
        - name: lesson_date
          type: date_text
          format_hint: "MM/DD/YYYY or local date format"
          example_value: "09/04/20XX"
          required: true
      placeholders:
        - "Math – 1st Period"
        - "Mr. Guerrero"
        - "09/04/20XX"

    - id: overview_purpose
      title: "Overview & Purpose"
      heading_text: "Overview & Purpose"
      content_summary: >
        High-level description of the lesson’s purpose and what the lesson is about.
        Currently filled with lorem ipsum placeholder text.
      body:
        type: rich_text_block
        content_example: >
          "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetuer adipiscing elit, sed diam nonummy
          nibh euismod tincidunt ut laoreet dolore magna aliquam erat volutpat."
      fillable_fields:
        - name: lesson_overview
          type: long_text
          guidance: "Summarize the main topic, context, and rationale for the lesson."
          required: true
      placeholders:
        - "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetuer adipiscing elit, sed diam nonummy nibh euismod tincidunt ut laoreet dolore magna aliquam erat volutpat."

    - id: education_standards
      title: "Education Standards"
      heading_text: "Education Standards"
      content_summary: >
        Space to list curricula or educational standards addressed by the lesson.
        Currently populated by short lorem ipsum bullet-like lines.
      body:
        type: bullet_like_text_lines
        content_example:
          - "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetuer adipiscing elit."
          - "Sed mollis aliquam nibh."
          - "Pellentesque pellentesque dictum urna."
      fillable_fields:
        - name: standards_aligned
          type: multi_line_text
          guidance: "List specific standards (e.g., Common Core codes, state standards)."
          required: true
      placeholders:
        - "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetuer adipiscing elit."
        - "Sed mollis aliquam nibh."
        - "Pellentesque pellentesque dictum urna."

    - id: objectives
      title: "Objectives"
      heading_text: "Objectives"
      content_summary: >
        Section for learning objectives describing what students should know or be
        able to do after the lesson. Filled with placeholder statements.
      body:
        type: bullet_like_text_lines
        content_example:
          - "Vivamus gravida lorem vel neque pulvinar bibendum."
          - "Aenean vestibulum odio faucibus sapien."
          - "Pellentesque accumsan auctor tortor."
      fillable_fields:
        - name: learning_objectives
          type: multi_line_text
          guidance: >
            List 2–5 specific, measurable objectives (e.g., 'Students will be able to…').
          required: true
      placeholders:
        - "Vivamus gravida lorem vel neque pulvinar bibendum."
        - "Aenean vestibulum odio faucibus sapien."
        - "Pellentesque accumsan auctor tortor."

    - id: materials_needed
      title: "Materials Needed"
      heading_text: "Materials Needed"
      content_summary: >
        List of materials required for the lesson, given as sample items with quantities.
      body:
        type: bullet_list
        items_example:
          - "Pellentesque (30)"
          - "Ut ullamcorper ultricies est (5)"
      fillable_fields:
        - name: materials_list
          type: structured_list
          item_fields:
            - item_name: short_text
            - quantity: number_or_text
          guidance: "List all supplies and resources needed (worksheets, manipulatives, tech, etc.)."
          required: true
      placeholders:
        - "Pellentesque (30)"
        - "Ut ullamcorper ultricies est (5)"

    - id: verification
      title: "Verification"
      heading_text: "Verification"
      content_summary: >
        Section describing how the teacher will check for student understanding during
        or after the lesson.
      subheading:
        type: static_text
        text: "Steps to check for student understanding"
      body:
        type: bullet_like_text_lines
        content_example:
          - "Vivamus ultrices eros nec lectus interdum condimentum."
          - "Cras vel felis a leo pretium pulvinar."
          - "Curabitur tincidunt elementum ante"
      fillable_fields:
        - name: verification_methods
          type: long_text_or_list
          guidance: >
            Describe formative assessments, questioning strategies, exit tickets, or
            other checks for understanding.
          required: true
      placeholders:
        - "Vivamus ultrices eros nec lectus interdum condimentum."
        - "Cras vel felis a leo pretium pulvinar."
        - "Curabitur tincidunt elementum ante"

    - id: activity
      title: "Activity"
      heading_text: "Activity"
      content_summary: >
        Main learning activity to reinforce lesson concepts. Contains a brief prompt
        plus placeholder paragraph text.
      prompt:
        type: static_text
        text: "Describe activity that will reinforce the lesson"
      body:
        type: rich_text_block
        content_example: >
          "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetuer adipiscing elit, sed diam nonummy
          nibh euismod tincidunt ut laoreet dolore magna aliquam erat volutpat."
      fillable_fields:
        - name: activity_description
          type: long_text
          guidance: >
            Provide step-by-step description of the learning activity, including timing,
            grouping, and procedures.
          required: true
      placeholders:
        - "Describe activity that will reinforce the lesson"
        - "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetuer adipiscing elit, sed diam nonummy nibh euismod tincidunt ut laoreet dolore magna aliquam erat volutpat."

  global_placeholders:
    description: >
      The document uses lorem ipsum Latin text and generic sample lines as placeholders
      for actual lesson content. All such lines should be replaced with real lesson
      descriptions, standards, objectives, materials, and activity details.
    examples:
      - generic_lorem_ipsum_paragraphs
      - short_placeholder_sentences_under_each_heading
      - sample_material_names_with_quantities

  logical_fields_index:
    teacher_information:
      - header.teacher_name
    class_information:
      - header.class_or_course_name
      - header.lesson_date
    planning_information:
      - overview_purpose.lesson_overview
      - education_standards.standards_aligned
      - objectives.learning_objectives
      - materials_needed.materials_list
      - verification.verification_methods
      - activity.activity_description

file_info:
  file_name: "Limiting_Competition_Under_250K_MANDATORY.pdf"
  brief_description: >
    Fillable justification template for limiting competition on U.S. Army/DoD
    contract actions over the micro-purchase threshold ($10K) and under the
    Simplified Acquisition Threshold (SAT), for use under FAR Parts 8, 13, or 16,
    including brand name and limited/only-one-source justifications.

  main_sections:
    - title: Header / Applicability Notice
      description: >
        Introductory text explaining the form is for actions over the
        micro-purchase threshold and under the SAT, for FAR Parts 8, 13, or 16,
        including brand name requirements and limited competition.
      elements:
        - static_text: "For All Actions Over the Micro-Purchase Threshold ($10K*) and Under the Simplified Acquisition Threshold (SAT)"
        - static_text: "Use for FAR Part 8, 13, or 16, Including Brand Name"
        - static_text: "MFR – Limiting Competition under SAT"

    - number: 1
      title: "Contracting Activity"
      description: >
        Identifies the contracting organization responsible for the action.
      fields:
        - name: contracting_activity
          label: "Contracting Activity"
          example_value: "U.S. Army Contracting Command – Rock Island, Rock Island Arsenal, Rock Island IL 61299-8000."
          type: text_line
          required: true

    - number: 2
      title: "Description of Action"
      description: >
        Describes the nature and basic facts of the procurement action.
      subparts:
        - label: "Nature"
          type: choice_multi
          options:
            - "New Requirement"
            - "Follow-on Requirement"
          notes: >
            User selects the applicable nature of the requirement (may be
            checkboxes or similar indicators).
        - label: "Description of Supplies/Services"
          type: text_block
          present: true
        - label: "Estimated Dollar Value"
          type: numeric_currency
          present: true
        - label: "Contract/Order Type and Period of Performance"
          type: text_block
          present: true

    - number: 3
      title: "Authority"
      description: >
        Citations for limiting competition under applicable FAR provisions,
        including brand name and only-one-source scenarios.
      fields:
        - type: group
          label: "FAR 8.405-6 Authorities (Federal Supply Schedules)"
          options:
            - code: "FAR 8.405-6(a)(1)(i)(B)"
              text: "Brand Name"
            - code: "FAR 8.405-6(a)(1)(i)(B)"
              text: "Only One Source is Capable"
            - code: "FAR 8.405-6(a)(1)(i)(C)"
              text: "Logical Follow-on"
          selection_type: choice_single_or_multi
        - type: group
          label: "FAR 16.505 Authorities (Task/Delivery Orders)"
          options:
            - heading_text: "Or"
            - code: "FAR 16.505(b)(2)(i)(B) and 16.505(a)(4)"
              text: "Brand Name"
            - code: "FAR 16.505(b)(2)(i)(A)"
              text: "Urgency"
            - code: "FAR 16.505(b)(2)(i)(B)"
              text: "Only One Awardee is Capable"
            - code: "FAR 16.505(b)(2)(i)(C)"
              text: "Logical Follow-on"
          selection_type: choice_single_or_multi
      notes: >
        The user must select the specific FAR authority(ies) relied upon to
        justify limiting competition.

    - number: 5
      title: "Reasons for Authority Cited"
      description: >
        Narrative justification supporting the selected FAR authority for
        limiting competition.
      subparts:
        - letter: a
          label: "Explanation of Intended Contractor Selection / Capabilities"
          description: >
            Requires explanation of why the intended source is being selected
            and why other sources are not acceptable or capable.
          type: text_block
          required: true
        - letter: b
          label: "Impact if Requirement Not Approved"
          type: text_block
          required: possibly
        - letter: c
          label: "Additional Justification Details as Required by Regulation"
          type: text_block
          present: true

    - number: 7
      title: "Market Research"
      description: >
        Documents the extent of market research performed and results, including
        efforts to identify all qualified sources and any pricing/competitive
        information obtained.
      fields:
        - name: market_research_description
          label: "Describe the extent of the market research conducted to identify all qualified sources and the results thereof."
          type: text_block
          required: true
        - name: market_research_supporting_data
          label: "Provide monetary or other data to support the reasonableness of the proposed price."
          type: text_block
          required: true

    - section: Signature_Block
      title: "Approvals / Signature"
      description: >
        Formal approval section for the Contracting Officer and instructions for
        post-approval handling.
      elements:
        - placeholder_line: "______________________________________________"
          label: "Signature line for Contracting Officer"
          type: signature_line
        - role_label: "Contracting Officer"
          type: static_text
        - instruction_text: >
            "After approval by the PCO, include a copy in the contract file.
             Send approved justification to CONOPS for redacting prior to
             posting, usarmy.ria.acc.mbx.spt-svcs@mail.mil."
        - name: contracting_officer_name
          type: text_line
          placeholder: "Name of Contracting Officer"
          required: true
        - name: contracting_officer_title
          type: text_line
          placeholder: "Title / Position"
          required: false
        - name: date_signed
          type: date
          placeholder: "Date"
          required: true

  fillable_or_logical_fields_summary:
    text_entry_fields:
      - contracting_activity
      - description_of_action_text (freeform narrative under Section 2)
      - estimated_value
      - period_of_performance
      - reasons_for_authority_cited (multiple narrative subparts)
      - market_research_description
      - market_research_supporting_data
      - contracting_officer_name
      - contracting_officer_title
      - date_signed
    choice_fields:
      - requirement_nature:
          options: ["New Requirement", "Follow-on Requirement"]
      - authority_under_FAR_8_405_6:
          options:
            - "Brand Name"
            - "Only One Source is Capable"
            - "Logical Follow-on"
      - authority_under_FAR_16_505:
          options:
            - "Brand Name"
            - "Urgency"
            - "Only One Awardee is Capable"
            - "Logical Follow-on"
    signature_fields:
      - contracting_officer_signature_line

  placeholders_and_notable_static_text:
    - type: monetary_threshold_note
      text: "For All Actions Over the Micro-Purchase Threshold ($10K*) and Under the Simplified Acquisition Threshold (SAT)"
    - type: authority_headers
      texts:
        - "FAR 8.405-6(a)(1)(i)(B) and 8.405-6(b)(1) Brand Name"
        - "FAR 16.505(b)(2)(i)(B) and 16.505(a)(4) Brand Name"
    - type: email_instruction
      text: "Send approved justification to CONOPS for redacting prior to posting, usarmy.ria.acc.mbx.spt-svcs@mail.mil."
    - type: signature_placeholder
      text: "______________________________________________ (Signature  Contracting Officer)"

  assumptions_and_gaps:
    - The exact wording and numbering of some subsections (e.g., within Sections 2 and 5) are inferred from partial text and typical form structures; actual PDF fields may differ slightly.
    - Presence and formatting of additional administrative fields (e.g., document number, PR number, CLINs, etc.) are not fully visible in the extracted text and therefore are not explicitly listed.
